scope:
Separate native TP scalar/cohort timeline; never throughput evidence.

Batch has one native_unsplit C-call range for eight logical requests. Scalar has
eight native_unsplit submitting-thread ranges. Do not equate range/request count.

batch_info.projection_precision_scope: Original Q8 weights/scales; torch.float16 storage/KV, FP32 GDN. q8-residual uses explicit group32 activation high/residual Q8 passes with FP32 scales and changed reduction order; not original FP16 arithmetic. Column MLP keeps partial outputs/host transport FP32, then sums before one FP16 cast; changed FP32 association versus full-K down, not prior-profile byte parity. Head-local GDN output also uses FP32 column partial/host transport/sum before one FP16 cast; changed FP32 association, not prior-profile byte parity.
batch_info.mlp_down_weight_layout: bit-preserving input-column halves, original group32 scales
batch_info.gdn_weight_layout: bit-preserved semantic Q/K/V head rows and group32 output-column halves
batch_info.gdn_state_layout: private packed FP32 value-head halves, split convolution histories and MTP prefixes on both devices; canonical joining diagnostics only
batch_info.distributed_memory_scope: all_request_device_bytes is primary; all_peer_request_device_bytes is additional GDN cache. MTP backup totals already include their reported peer component.
batch_info.scope: Shared model/workspace counts once; request bytes per slot. Generation counters are shared per most recent cohort, never summed per response. Fixed cohort admission, no MTP/continuous batching/paging.
